name: Mira
lore: A survivor rebuilding a home for those the Crown displaced.

name: Sera, Mountain Scout
lore: Her signal fire once guided caravans through the pass. She puts people before relics.

name: Brother Orin
lore: The last reader of the glacier oath. He believes the sentinel can remember its purpose.

name: Marin, Tide Broker
lore: A former smuggler who now moves medicine instead of contraband.

name: Keeper Ilyra
lore: She preserves a coastal beacon and the names of the sailors it could not save.
